name: ai-toolkit
description: ITSolve-dev shared AI toolkit — reusable skills, agents and plugins across projects.

plugins.name: llm-wiki
plugins.description: LLM-maintained knowledge wiki following Andrej Karpathy's llm-wiki pattern: ingest sources, compile durable pages, query, lint. Includes the wiki-keeper expert agent, a local browser preview, and adapters for the common source formats.

plugins.name: domain-driven-guide
plugins.description: Domain-Driven Design guidance grounded in a curated knowledge base bundled with the plugin: questions answered with citations, and skills for modelling and reviewing a domain.
